precepts.text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth. There shall come a Star out of Jacob. Out of who? Out of Jacob. Did it say out of Esau? And a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel: a ruler shall rise out of Israel. And shall smite the corners of Moab, the Moabites.
precepts.point: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star. So who is the morning star? Christ is the morning star. But why is it referring to Lucifer as the morning star?
precepts.why:
Christ says, “I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.” So who is the morning star? Christ is the morning star. Then why is Lucifer called “son of the morning”? The King James is the only version with Lucifer there, because the scholars who translated it understood something everybody else did not: there is a difference between that morning star and the morning star we read about all through the scriptures.

Balaam saw the true star: “I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob”. A star out of who? Out of Jacob. Did it say out of Esau? No: out of Jacob.

“and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel”: a ruler shall rise out of Israel. “and shall smite the corners of Moab”, the Moabites, the Chinese, “and destroy all the children of Sheth.”

So the star in the scriptures is Christ, the ruler rising out of Israel, the offspring of David. The star comes out of Jacob, not Esau, and that is how we know the one called Lucifer, the false morning star, is a different one.

precepts.text: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts. So you see who is referred to as the star, the bright morning star.
precepts.point: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star. So who is the morning star? Christ is the morning star. But why is it referring to Lucifer as the morning star?
precepts.why:
“We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts”. So you see who is referred to as the star, the bright morning star: Christ, the day star that arises in your hearts.

Then why is the king of Babylon, America, referred to as Lucifer? Because “such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.” “And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.” The white man came and taught another Christ and transformed himself into an apostle of Christ. America transformed itself in the 1950s into a God-loving Christian nation, and for the last seventy years has pushed that it is here to set up righteousness and justice on the earth, after murdering, stealing, colonizing and enslaving millions of people.

That is why Isaiah calls him “Lucifer, son of the morning”: he says he is Christian, righteous, the light, and makes himself look like the morning star. But Christ is the real morning star, “the true Light”, and the day star Peter speaks of arises in the hearts of those who take heed to the sure word of prophecy.

precepts.text: Behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be. Do not let anybody trick you out of your reward.
precepts.point: How do you go about not being beguiled? If you study, you do not willingly give yourself over to men that will deceive you by handling the word of God deceitfully. Study to shew thyself approved, that you will be able to withstand these men.
precepts.why:
“Let no man beguile you of your reward”. What reward? Christ says: “And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.”

Christ comes quickly, and his reward is with him, to give every man of the children of Israel according as his work shall be. That is the reward Paul is guarding in Colossians 2:18.

To beguile is to deceive, to trick. So “Let no man beguile you of your reward” means: don't let nobody trick you out of getting your reward in Christ. The men with enticing words and bright ideas are not only leading you astray in doctrine; they are robbing you of what Christ is bringing with him when he comes. Your work is what the reward answers to, so don't let a man turn your work away from Christ.

precepts.text: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie. None of that is going into the kingdom. Even liars, people that deal falsely, that lie by omission, that hold back when they know exactly what you're asking them: the Lord marks that down too.
precepts.point: And it shall come to pass, that when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, Thou shalt not live; and shall thrust him through when he prophesieth. Why would his own father and mother do that? Because they will have already witnessed how Christ dealt with the rebellious. Once those parents see that Christ isn't playing, that's how the parents are going to be moving. I'm going back to you brothers and sisters with sons and daughters that refuse to change: don't put your life on the line for wickedness that refuses to repent.

note.label: In a Game of Fools Without The Rules

precepts.why:
Zechariah says the Lord will “cut off the names of the idols out of the land” and “cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.” This craziness on this side is not coming into the kingdom. Revelation shows who stays outside: “For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.”

Without the kingdom are dogs, meaning the other nations. Sorcerers: witchcraft. Whoremongers, murderers, idolaters: you are not getting the kingdom, and it is Christ saying it. And whosoever loveth and maketh a lie: if you even lie, your ass ain't going in.

That includes people that deal falsely: you ask them a question and they try to be slick with their answer, hiding things, lying by omission. That is what thou shalt not lie nor deal falsely means: holding back. Some of our kids lie right in your face, insulting your intelligence, acting like they don't know what you are really asking, as if the Lord isn't hearing it. The Lord is marking that down too; the angels heard it.

All of this is purged before we get to the kingdom. Zechariah's day is in the wilderness, right before we get to our kingdom, the same way the Lord purged us when we came out of Egypt: forty years in the wilderness until those who rebelled were wiped out. None of that evil is going to make it there.

precepts.text: The angel says the same thing again: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets. Worship God.
precepts.point: John fell at the angel's feet to worship him, and he said, See thou do it not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren. The angels are our brethren; the angels have tribes too. In Revelation 21, do not be surprised if the angels at the twelve gates stand each at the gate of their tribe.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

precepts.why:
John says it twice. In Revelation 19 he fell at the angel's feet, and here again: “I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.”

And the angel says the same thing again: “See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.” He will not take worship, because he is not God. He is a fellowservant, one of the brethren.

That is who the angels are: our brothers. They are not demons. They ate with Lot because they have mouths just like us, and they were going to lie down because they look like us. Esau calls them humanoids, and to Esau they are going to be some demons, but those are our brothers. The angels have tribes too, and in Revelation 21, do not be surprised if the angels standing at the twelve gates are each standing at the gate of their own tribe.

precepts.text: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life and enter in through the gates.
precepts.point: Abraham was justified by works when he offered Isaac; faith wrought with his works and by works was faith made perfect, and he was called the friend of God. By works a man is justified and not by faith only, as Romans 2:13 said, and Rahab was justified by works when she sent the spies out another way. As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

note.label: Navigating Through Paul's Letters: Works Of The Law & Liberty

precepts.why:
The saints “keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus”, and Revelation shows what the commandments are for: “Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.”

That do his commandments: deeds, actions, works. They must do the commandments to enter in through the gates, and have faith in Christ. They go hand in hand.

That is James’ point: “Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.” A man who says he has faith but does no works, who will not keep the commandments, has no right to the tree of life. Christ redeemed us from the death that came from breaking the law, and put us under the law of liberty, “So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.” The doing is what gives the right to enter the city.

precepts.text: I am the root and the offspring of David.
precepts.point: As concerning the gospel they are enemies for your sakes, but as touching the election they are beloved for the fathers' sakes. As ye in times past had not believed God but now have obtained mercy through their unbelief, so they through your mercy may obtain mercy. God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all: all Israel.

note.label: The Dividing Hatred: the Grafted in Strangers

precepts.why:
“And if the root be holy, so are the branches.” Who is the root? Christ says it himself: “I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David”.

And who are the branches? Christ said in John 15, “I am the vine, ye are the branches.” The branches go into the offspring, the children: us. If the root is holy, so are the branches that grow out of him.

That is what “the root and fatness of the olive tree” is in verse 17. Both kingdoms partake of Christ; he rules over them both. And it is why Paul warns, “Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.” If you boast against your brothers, you are not following Christ; it is Christ, the root, that bears you.

So the root being holy is the reason the natural branches can be grafted in again and the wild branches can be grafted in at all. Everything grows out of Christ, the root and offspring of David.

precepts.text: I am thy fellow servant, and of thy brethren the prophets.
precepts.point: The angel who spoke to John called himself his fellow servant and his brother.

note.label: The Kingdom Of Adam And The Old World

precepts.why:
When the world was not yet made, “no man spake against me”: everyone obeyed. We were there with the Lord in the beginning in our angelic bodies, not in this wicked fleshly body. To see what that means, look at the angel who spoke to John.

John fell down to worship before the feet of the angel, and the angel said, “See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.” I am a servant just like you. I am your brother. I am a prophet. And I am of them which keep the sayings of this book. That is heavy.

So now you understand a little more what the Lord means when he says that when we were with him in the beginning, we all obeyed. The angels are our brethren; we had that same celestial body with him before the earth was created, and that is why Christ says those who understand the power of God will be equal unto the angels. Now, covered in this flesh, we are rebellious, and the Lord has to keep whooping us for our idols and our evil. But you have to see who you are and believe it. This is not a fairy tale; this is real.

precepts.text: A pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne.
precepts.point: Sirach names the same rivers as the flow of understanding, and the sea of glass is that clear water in heaven.

note.label: The Kingdom Of Adam And The Old World

precepts.why:
Wisdom said her river became a sea. Revelation 15:2: “And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass”. We overcame the white man and his lies, and we stand on that clear water. The Lord divided the waters from the waters above, and the waters above are the wisdom in paradise.

Revelation 22 shows the river of Eden in heaven: “And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb. In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.” A river, and the tree of life beside it, just as in the garden.

In Revelation 4, “a door was opened in heaven”, and the voice said, “Come up hither”. John went up into paradise, and that is where those things were shown to him. “And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal”. The sea of glass is the wisdom coming from the throne of God. Esau pictures it as the Bifrost, a bridge leading to paradise.

Psalm 148:4 calls on those waters: “Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.” Song of Solomon 4 calls it “a well of living waters”. Christ said he is the living water, and told the woman at the well he would give her living water. Those are the waters above the heavens, the springs up there. The river out of Eden is that same water.

precepts.text: She is the breath of the power of God and the brightness of the everlasting light: the river is wisdom.
precepts.point: The pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, is the word of God.

precepts.text: My lips shall utter knowledge clearly: the laws of God are clear to the righteous, so the water is clear as crystal.
precepts.point: The pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, is the word of God.

precepts.text: I am the root and the offspring of David: he formed David and he came out of David, which is why he asked the Pharisees that question.
precepts.point: In all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, and in all things is the emphasis: his brethren were made through a father and a mother.

note.label: Escape Thankskilling : Oh God & My Lord

precepts.text: I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star; the Star out of Jacob is Christ.
precepts.point: There shall come a Star out of Jacob: the Star is Christ, the root and offspring of David, the bright and morning star. And a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel: the sceptre belongs to kings, so the prophecy is that the King shall rise out of Israel.

note.label: Numbers 24: A Star out of Jacob and the Latter Days

precepts.why:
“there shall come a Star out of Jacob”: the Star is Christ. “I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.”

Christ is the root and the offspring of David, the bright and morning star, and He came out of Jacob. That is the Star Balaam saw in the latter days, but not nigh.

precepts.text: If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues written in this book, and if any man take away from the words, God shall take away his part out of the book of life.
precepts.point: The watered down versions such as the NIV and ESV show what taking away looks like: many of them remove Matthew 18:11 and other scriptures, and they have taken out the Apocrypha.
precepts.why:
On the last page of the Bible the charge Moses gave around 1500 BC closes the book: “If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city”.

Moses said neither add unto the word nor diminish ought from it; John says the same thing across millenniums and captivities. That consistency proves the Bible is a true book, because twenty people cannot keep one story straight for five minutes.

Taking away is what the watered down versions such as the NIV and ESV show: many of them remove Matthew 18:11 and other scriptures, and they have taken out the Apocrypha. Adding sounds like god loves everybody. Both carry a judgment: the plagues written in the book for the one who adds, and his part taken out of the book of life for the one who takes away.

precepts.text: Blessed are they that do his commandments; for without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers.
precepts.point: Christ told a woman of another nation it is not meet to take the children's bread and cast it to dogs, and she said, Truth, Lord; and four-legged dogs did not pierce Christ's hands and feet, for the dogs that compassed him were the other nations, in that case the Romans.

note.label: Deuteronomy 23: Who May Enter the Congregation and the Holy Camp

precepts.why:
“Thou shalt not bring the hire of a whore, or the price of a dog, into the house of the Lord thy God for any vow: for even both these are abomination unto the Lord thy God.” Who is the dog? “Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city. For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.”

Without are dogs: that is not the four-legged barking kind, but the other nations, outside the city while they that do his commandments enter in through the gates. Whoremongers are without with them, and there are the whore and the dog of this law together.

precepts.text: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life; the blessing at the last page of the book.
precepts.point: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded which Joshua read not before all the congregation, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them: those were the strangers that fell in line with Israel, with the fear of the Lord in them, as Rahab had.

note.label: Joshua 8: The Taking of Ai and the Blessings and Cursings

precepts.why:
How do you become blessed? Read the last page of the book: “Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.” A few verses before your Bible says the end, it says keep the commandments. So no man in his right mind can say the laws are done away with; that is justifying wickedness.

The blessings Joshua read before all the congregation are the blessings at the last page of the book, and they come the same way. Keep the sabbath holy, leave the swine alone, dress in modesty, and keep the commandments if you want the blessings.

precepts.text: John the revelator, the disciple whom Christ loved, fell down to worship before the feet of the angel, and the angel said, see thou do it not, for I am thy fellowservant and of thy brethren the prophets: worship God.
precepts.point: Manoah still did not know that he was an angel of the Lord.

note.label: Judges 13: A Nazarite from the Womb

precepts.why:
Even John the revelator, the disciple whom Christ loved, made the mistake the angel was guarding Manoah from: “I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things. Then saith he unto me, See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.”

The angel of the Lord did the same with Manoah: “I will not eat of thy bread”, and a burnt offering “thou must offer it unto the Lord.” Angels of the Most High refuse worship and point it to God. Israel is quick to worship anything that looks like it could be God because we cannot see the Most High, so the scripture keeps the line plain: worship God.

precepts.text: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life and enter through the gates into the city.
precepts.point: Righteousness goes into the commandments. That is how we get salvation, the kingdom of heaven, eternal life.

note.label: Psalm 132: The Oath to David and the Throne Forever

precepts.why: “I will also clothe her priests with salvation”. The priest will teach our lost people how to get salvation, and salvation comes by doing the righteousness of this book, keeping the laws of the Most High: “Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.” That is how we get salvation, the kingdom of heaven, eternal life.

“Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.” While you are busy swallowing down the greatness of the prophecies, you are choking on the commandments, the little things: love your neighbor as yourself, thou shalt not bear false witness. When the deacons came in, there were two years with no prophecy: get your house in order, learn the commandments, start with the milk. The milk benefited them. The dangers that happened to the disciples of Christ are going to happen again.
The precept for the pure river: “And, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward.”
“That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word”: when John and Ezekiel see water gushing out from the temple, it all symbolizes the word of God.

“But his delight is in the law of the Lord; and in his law doth he meditate day and night. And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season”: he brings forth understanding in his season. “His leaf also shall not wither”: his understanding shall not wither. This is why we must not walk in the counsel of the ungodly. All our judgments must be Bible based; videos and audios don’t persuade us, we go by scripture, like Matthew 18.
“The knowledge of the commandments of the Lord is the doctrine of life: and they that do things that please him shall receive the fruit of the tree of immortality.”
What the curse is: “Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them.”

“For now we see through a glass, darkly”: the glass is the Bible. We read it like we have shades on; some things we see, some we don’t, until we read it again years later. That is Ezekiel 47: the understanding at the ankles, then the knees, then the loins, then covering the earth. “But then face to face”: the Lord will deal with us face to face. “Now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known”: the Lord knows each one of us; even the hairs of our head are all numbered.

When we are delivered from Babylon and the lands we are scattered in: “And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people”: the same wilderness we were in with Moses. “And there will I plead with you face to face.”

“And they shall look upon me whom they have pierced”: we will literally see Christ, with that same body that was pierced. “And they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son”: we will feel like it was our only child that died.

“For my determination is to gather the nations.” “For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the Lord, to serve him with one consent”: for then, after he destroys the armies of the nations. That means right now everyone is not calling on the Lord with one consent. We are not arguing with other camps over how to pronounce the name; to prove the pronunciation you would have to go back in time and hear the Hebrew, so everything we have now is by faith. Keep the commandments.

Brothers who say we already have the name contradict scripture: “And I will write upon him the name of my God.” “And I will write upon him my new name”: Christ has a new name, and it won’t be in English. It will be the pure tongue the Lord sets up, not the confusion out here today.

The Hebrew was already changing in Christ’s day: “Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.” Some of the people that heard the Hebrew mistook what he was saying, and that lets you know the language had changed somewhat.

“Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the Lord shall be thine everlasting light”: that is our understanding. We are not going to lose our understanding ever again.

For the many who say the Bible is not faithful and true, this is what you say to the scoffer: “Produce your cause, saith the Lord; bring forth your strong reasons.” “Let them bring them forth, and shew us what shall happen”: show us in ancient writings why we went into slavery on ships, what will happen to America, Syria, Egypt. Islam, Christianity, the Gilgamesh epic, the Quran, the books of Buddha and Krishna can’t do it; only the Bible can. “Let them shew the former things, what they be, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them.” “Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye are gods”: some say the black man is God; then why did God go into slavery? “Behold, ye are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination is he that chooseth you”: anyone who chooses Islam or Christianity is an abomination.
Why you will be blessed if you keep the sayings of this book: “Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.”

“But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end”: the understanding of what the Bible is talking about would come at the time of the end. That is why men and women are waking up and know they are Israelites now: the seals are being taken off. We are in the time of the end.

“An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked”: this is why the wicked despise Israel United in Christ and try to bring us down any chance they get.

“How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?”: sin is sweet to them; they have no scruples about anything wicked. When sin doesn’t bother you, when deceit comes out of your mouth and it feels normal, something is wrong. Pray to the Lord to change your spirit.

“Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law”: that is how you know you are on the right path. If the law is in your heart you have boundaries. “Fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings”: this is why we don’t fear the videos coming out against us.
He that is holy: “Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.” To be holy and righteous we must keep God’s law; that is Revelation 14:12.

“And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end”: until we die. “To him will I give power over the nations”: I want that reward. “And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers”: we are not going to have mercy on the other nations. When the white man conquered us, he broke us and changed our thinking; when we rule this earth, we will break these nations to the will of God. “Even as I received of my Father”: we will get the same blessing Christ received.
“For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead. For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.”
The genealogy on Mary’s side, from her father Heli, Joseph’s father-in-law: “Which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.”

“The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit”: quickening means converting, changing. “The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.” Paul was very heavy in his understanding; we will go into this in greater detail in other classes. Some things we speak plain, some we don’t.

In case you forgot about the tree of life: “The knowledge of the commandments of the Lord is the doctrine of life: and they that do things that please him shall receive the fruit of the tree of immortality.”
The gates we all want to go through: “And had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.”

These are not four-legged dogs; he is talking about the two-legged dogs. “Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers”: the Bible calls evil workers dogs. “Beware of the concision”: people that talk at the mouth and aren’t saying anything, like the scribes and Pharisees.

Sorcerers: the coconut under somebody’s bed, the tarot cards, the Ouija board. “That maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire”: that is abortion, killing your babies. “Or that useth divination”: rolling bones on the floor. “Or an observer of times”: the horoscope. “Or an enchanter”: casting spells on people. “Or a witch”: a female. “Or a charmer”: the lucky charm, the rabbit’s foot, the four-leaf clover. “Or a consulter with familiar spirits”: like the movie Ghost, your dead aunt has a message for you. “Or a wizard”: the male version. “Or a necromancer”: someone that talks with the dead, like the woman who raised up Samuel.

Even if you have never done those things: “For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft”: if you are rebellious to the laws of God, you are like a witch or a wizard. “And stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry”: stubborn to the laws of God, you are like an idol.

Whoremongers are promiscuous men: “All bread is sweet to a whoremonger, he will not leave off till he die”: all he cares about is sexual gratification. Sisters who leave their husbands to find another man end up with this man, who will leave them and the children. Be patient and abide in God’s commandments.

The woman: “Thus shall it go also with the wife that leaveth her husband, and bringeth in an heir by another. For first, she hath disobeyed the law of the most High; and secondly, she hath trespassed against her own husband; and thirdly, she hath played the whore in adultery, and brought children by another man.” “Her children shall not take root, and her branches shall bring forth no fruit”: in the past, nobody in the whole nation of Israel married a child born of adultery.

It was a shame, and we have to bring that shame back: “In her virginity, lest she should be defiled and gotten with child in her father’s house.” Today it is socially acceptable, with new titles like baby daddy.
Murderers in the spiritual context: “Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.”

If you are in the midst of evil, these scriptures should shame you to repentance. “Whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment”: when a man says I apologize, it is over; if you hold on to it, that is a grudge, and the sin is on you. “And whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council”: brothers or sisters constantly insulting one another. “But whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire”: they never repented, so they are going to die.

Idolaters. They all say they worship the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, but you judge by actions; by him actions are weighed. If you worshipped him, you would apply Matthew 18 to a problem with your brother. “Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry.”

What they were covetous for: “For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.” Covetousness is idolatry.
Whosoever loveth and maketh a lie: “He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.” You are not entering the kingdom of heaven.

“If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?” Christ instructed us how to deal with one another; if you can’t do that, don’t say you love the Lord.

“Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters”: everybody that is thirsty, come get your thirst quenched with the word of God. “And he that hath no money”: it doesn’t matter if you don’t have money, come learn this truth. “Yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price”: that is why we put this on YouTube and Facebook free.

We must be thirsty for understanding, for truth, for the coming kingdom: “Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness.” When you lose that hunger and thirst, Satan has entered the building. Money is a necessity, but godliness with contentment is great gain; when you want more than contentment, you are no longer hungry for righteousness.

points: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star. So who is the morning star? Christ is the morning star. But why is it referring to Lucifer as the morning star?

Now this is really going into something spiritual, but I'm going to use the physical aspect of it to show you all the importance of herbs. In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life: one of these days we going to go over it with you all. Which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month. So this is literally something that John the revelator see; that's the kingdom of heaven.

And the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations: this is going into something spiritual, because we know the Lord heal us, we are healed through the word of God. But why is it saying the leaves of the trees? Because a lot of these trees on the earth, the leaves literally heal you. You all know it got the soursop leaves. Soursop leaves kill cancer cells, medically proven. We all got small amount of cancer cells in us, but it's when it's overgrown. In the morning you get up, you just boil some soursop leaf, boil some lime leaf, boil some cloves, boil the herbs and just drink a cup of tea. Just that alone kill cancer cells. It help you from getting sick. This is stuff you got to do every morning. But they don't teach you all this no more. In the islands when I woke up, we went outside and we put different leaves and we boil it and we drink some tea. That's how I grew up in the islands. I never go to the doctor unless it's something like I break my hand, I chop off my finger one time. But we usually just go outside, pick the herbs and make tea with it and we drink it every day. These things we got to start doing and implementing in your life, and it's going to help you to stay healthy. Don't wait till you get sick, now you running and looking for this and that. You need to start from now. Don't wait till the cancer cells become alert. You got to keep it under control, because the food that we eat, everything we eat get us sick and give us diseases.

And they're not talking about ganja, man, for you weed smokers. The leaves is not talking about that. It's talking for medication, healing. You know it was found on King Solomon's grave; he was the wisest man in these days.

Blessed are they that do his commandments. As we keep these commandments we are proving our worthiness; we are passing the grade, going from one grade to the next, one trial to the next, one temperament to the next. We have to grow in this truth. You see brothers that have been in this truth ten, fifteen years; Bishop almost thirty. You see what it looks like to do the work. Do you think there is a shortcut, that you can be in here one, two, three years and that is it, then go do your own thing with Bishop's precept book and start something new? You have leadership that has labored twenty plus years to do this work, and here you come, a brand new fool, with other fools following you.

That they may have right to the tree of life: meaning you earned it. When he puts the crown on your head, you earned it; you fought to the end, you did everything that was asked of you, you went from grade to grade. Job well done: you have been proven like fine gold; you passed the grade. You are not junk metal. Some are junk metal; fool's gold, just looking shiny, with the appearance of godliness.
The pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, is the word of God.
The tree of life bearing twelve manner of fruits, and the leaves of it for the healing of the nations.
Blessed are they that do his commandments. His commandments were not done away with; what was dealt with is the sacrifices that were tied to them.
That they may have right to the tree of life -- that is eternal life -- and may enter in through the gates into the city. And there are twelve of those gates.
Without are dogs. If you want in, humble yourself: we are your masters, we are the children of God, and you cleave to us as servants and handmaids. Start blessing us.

“And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb”: John is seeing a vision; it is written as a similitude, a metaphor, and we need the proper precepts to explain it. This is why the Old Testament is very important; the Christians who say don’t read it, it’s done away with, are agents of Satan. The water symbolizes the word of God. Do you see words coming in the air? No; it is a symbol.

“And on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month”: understanding came out every month. “And the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.”
“Was there the tree of life”: the tree of life is symbolic of the Lord giving immortality to his people, the elect.

“And there shall be no more curse”: we are not going to be destroyed or go into captivity ever again. Israel shall be all righteous, so that curse will be done away with. “But the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him.”

“And they shall see his face”: we will see Christ face to face, so don’t let there ever be the slightest doubt in your mind. “And his name shall be in their foreheads”: in their minds, when we overcome and meet him face to face, with the pure language.
“And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light”: that goes with Isaiah 60:20. “And they shall reign for ever and ever.”

“These sayings are faithful and true”: the same as Daniel 2, where the dream is certain. The sayings of this book shall surely come to pass. “The things which must shortly be done”: that is why we are going through this now, so you understand what will happen soon.
“Blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book”: you follow the scriptures as they come out, and the Bible says you will be blessed.

“I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel”: “See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets”: that is a heavy saying, for another class. A hint: in the book of Tobit the angel told Tobit he was of the tribe of such and such, of his brethren; the angel didn’t lie, we just don’t understand yet. “And of them which keep the sayings of this book”: first and foremost the book of Revelation, but it includes the entire Bible.
“Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand”: don’t hide understanding.

“He that is unjust, let him be unjust still”: the unjust falls amongst our people first and foremost; there will be some good and some bad. You decide you are unjust, then be unjust still. “And he which is filthy, let him be filthy still”: you want to be filthy, then stay filthy. “And he that is righteous, let him be righteous still”: I want the Lord to see me and you as righteous. There is such a thing as repentance: David repented, Solomon repented. “And he that is holy, let him be holy still.”
“And my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be”: this goes with Luke 19, be thou over ten cities, over five cities. These are the rewards according to our works.
“I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last”: we went over this last week, but some got confused. Christ is the first and the last.

“Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city”: I want to enter through the gates, whether I am dead in this life or alive and caught up. If I were another nation, I would pray to the Lord, just let me be a servant to your people Israel. This is why we do all this work: the reward of entering through the gates of the city.

“For without are dogs”: without means outside the gates of the city. “And sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters”: those who left and make video after video out of hatred for their brothers are murderers in the spiritual sense, and their covetousness is idolatry. “And whosoever loveth and maketh a lie”: some people love and make lies, and they made those videos to make lies; they edit them with jump cuts so it sounds like it flows.

“I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches”: the seven churches scattered throughout Asia. “I am the root and the offspring of David”: that is saying something, for another day.

“And the Spirit and the bride say, Come”: Christ is the Spirit, and we are the bride. “And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely”: you have to desire the water of life like a thirsty man or woman.

“If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book”: this is why we tell you to be mindful of the other books popping up, like Jasher and Enoch; they have been tampered with. Some say God had mercy on Esau and forgave him, which contradicts Hebrews 12, where there was no repentance for him. Stay away from those books.
“And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life”: the white man took words out.

“Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.” You might not have gained all the understanding yet, but rehearse your notes and pray to the Lord to open your understanding, as James 1 says: if any lack wisdom, let him ask. You will catch on.
